Comments (English): [ I could manage without it, but it would be incredibly difficult to lose it after having it. ] || ---------------- || Real review. Used for 3-4 days. Cleaning power: 5 out of 5. I tried to run various tests, but I haven't yet tried things like burnt marks on frying pans or completely dried-out rice grains stuck on. I've only used the 1-hour cycle, but dishes that were generally used and roughly rinsed with water were 100% perfectly clean. I used only one mini tablet of Frosh Green Lemon detergent. I put in about 5 rice bowls, 4 soup bowls, 1 frying pan, 5 cutlery sets, 1 medium-sized pot, 2 side dish containers, 2 slightly larger side dish bowls, and 6 cups. They all came out perfectly clean with just one mini tablet on the 1-hour cycle. Downside: It feels like a waste of detergent for running small loads. It cleans well regardless of how greasy the dishes are. By nature, I usually pre-wash dishes with water before placing them in the sink, but this time I rinsed them even more roughly with water just to remove any color from seasonings before putting them in. I just throw in greasy items as long as the color isn't visible. Even so, it cleans incredibly well—though I assume it depends on the detergent. Based on using Frosh detergent, when the door opens after a 1-hour cycle, there is almost no water left except for the grooved areas facing upwards. If I run it before bed, everything is dry by morning. Even if I take them out immediately after the 1-hour cycle, there is hardly any water. Dishes without grooves or cutlery are dry enough to be put away right away. I searched extensively on YouTube and in reviews to find answers to questions about cleaning power, and regarding comments about rice grains remaining, I think they fall into one of three categories: 1. Cases where completely dry rice grains are stuck, or eating habits where a lot of rice is left in the bowl without pre-washing. 2. Using a mild detergent. 3. Cases where dishes are piled high after eating 2 or 3 meals a day, preventing the water from properly reaching the rice grains. The washing process is quite quiet; while you can hear the sound of water splashing against the walls when rinsing or when the water jets powerfully spray, it isn't loud. It seems like the more dishes there are, the quieter it gets. The sound of water hitting the walls is the loudest. At first, the one-hour time felt long, but if you get distracted for even a moment, it's over. There are various cycles available, but without adding any options, the one-hour cycle is set to one hour. The standard cycle is displayed as 3 hours and 40 minutes, and the intensive cycle as 2 hours and 40 minutes. If you feel uneasy about the one-hour cycle and plan to use a different one, it will take a bit longer. Even the shortest cycle downloaded via LG Sync was 1 hour and 40 minutes. The manual states that the standard cycle reduces electricity consumption by slowly heating the water or something similar, but I don't think I'll ever need to use that. The design isn't as pretty as I expected; it looks like a mini refrigerator. I've heard so much about how great dishwashers are, and while I'm confused by the various reviews and opinions, having one is definitely convenient. With a family of six, washing dishes usually takes about 20 minutes on days with little to 30-40 minutes, but it is much more convenient to just put everything in and run it for an hour. The kids use a new cup every time they drink water, so the pile of cups is insane; I used to be stressed about washing them, but that stress disappeared instantly. You don't really need anything else; it is a must-have for any household where washing dishes takes about 30 minutes. Actually, 30 minutes is the washing itself, but if you add in the time for drying and tidying up, an hour feels like nothing. With the dishwasher, I just run the 1-hour cycle and don't really care whether I clean up or not. I usually just clear away the pots and pans and use the rest of the dishes immediately for the next meal, so it doesn't take any extra time. Also, I don't see a single grain of rice in the food strainer—perhaps because the water jet blows away soaked rice or rice from dishes I just ate from, turning it into powder and disappearing.

Comments (English): [ I could manage without it, but it would be incredibly difficult to lose it after having it. ] || ---------------- || Real review. Used for 3-4 days. Cleaning power: 5 out of 5. I tried to run various tests, but I haven't yet tried things like burnt marks on frying pans or completely dried-out rice grains stuck on. I've only used the 1-hour cycle, but dishes that were generally used and roughly rinsed with water were 100% perfectly clean. I used only one mini tablet of Frosh Green Lemon detergent. I put in about 5 rice bowls, 4 soup bowls, 1 frying pan, 5 cutlery sets, 1 medium-sized pot, 2 side dish containers, 2 slightly larger side dish bowls, and 6 cups. It cleans well regardless of how greasy the dishes are. Based on using Frosh detergent, when the door opens after a 1-hour cycle, there is almost no water left except for the grooved areas facing upwards. If I run it before bed, everything is dry by morning. Even if I take them out immediately after the 1-hour cycle, there is hardly any water. Dishes without grooves or cutlery are dry enough to be put away right away. I searched extensively on YouTube and in reviews to find answers to questions about cleaning power, and regarding comments about rice grains remaining, I think they fall into one of three categories: 1. Cases where completely dry rice grains are stuck, or eating habits where a lot of rice is left in the bowl without pre-washing. 2. Using a mild detergent. 3. Cases where dishes are piled high after eating 2 or 3 meals a day, preventing the water from properly reaching the rice grains. The washing process is quite quiet; while you can hear the sound of water splashing against the walls when rinsing or when the water jets powerfully spray, it isn't loud. It seems like the more dishes there are, the quieter it gets. The sound of water hitting the walls is the loudest. At first, the one-hour time felt long, but if you get distracted for even a moment, it's over. There are various cycles available, but without adding any options, the one-hour cycle is set to one hour. The standard cycle is displayed as 3 hours and 40 minutes, and the intensive cycle as 2 hours and 40 minutes. If you feel uneasy about the one-hour cycle and plan to use a different one, it will take a bit longer. Even the shortest cycle downloaded via LG Sync was 1 hour and 40 minutes. The manual states that the standard cycle reduces electricity consumption by slowly heating the water or something similar, but I don't think I'll ever need to use that. The design isn't as pretty as I expected; it looks like a mini refrigerator. I've heard so much about how great dishwashers are, and while I'm confused by the various reviews and opinions, having one is definitely convenient. With a family of six, washing dishes usually takes about 20 minutes on days with little to 30-40 minutes, but it is much more convenient to just put everything in and run it for an hour. The kids use a new cup every time they drink water, so the pile of cups is insane; I used to be stressed about washing them, but that stress disappeared instantly. You don't really need anything else; it is a must-have for any household where washing dishes takes about 30 minutes. Actually, 30 minutes is the washing itself, but if you add in the time for drying and tidying up, an hour feels like nothing. With the dishwasher, I just run the 1-hour cycle and don't really care whether I clean up or not. I usually just clear away the pots and pans and use the rest of the dishes immediately for the next meal, so it doesn't take any extra time. Also, I don't see a single grain of rice in the food strainer—perhaps because the water jet blows away soaked rice or rice from dishes I just ate from, turning it into powder and disappearing.

Maybe the younger generation or someone with a smart house will enjoy this dishwasher, but I would prefer a dishwasher that I can load, add soap, press delay for a few hours, hit start and see a clean light when I get up in the morning.

Comments (English): [ Perfect! ] || ---------------- || Almost everything about this dishwasher is great. It has the best quality on the market, it is silent, and the shelves are phenomenal. But, there's a few tweaks that could be made. There is no button to turn on or off the clean dishes light or internal lights. This makes it so if you accidentally close the dishwasher after the dishes have been cleaned the clean dishes light will clear and there is no way to re enable it. Although this of course is a nit-pick. The filter has worked great and been easy to clean. The slots on the utensils bin are skinny and may not fit all spoons and forks. There is a dedicated metal straw cleaning spot that is convenient. And the door open feature is great. The sanitize feature is additionally NSF certified. This dishwasher is not WiFi enabled which may be a pro for some or a con for others. Overall it does exactly what you want. I do recommend scrubbing hard stuck on messes ahead of time as they may come out only partially clean just like most other dishwashers. The 3rd cup rack fits standard 7oz and 14 oz glasses as well as 1 cup measuring cups and the tray is able to hold 1 scrub daddy and 1 scour daddy so it works great for our family. The back rack of the bottom shelf also fits kitchenaid mixer bowls which is also a nice plus. I searched for 2 weeks looking at every dishwasher model from Bosch, lg, whirlpool, Frigidaire, cafe, Samsung, Maytag, and many more. No other dishwashers came to have as good build quality as this one which was the biggest thing for us. The kitchenaid customer support was also amazing when registering the manufacturer warranty and installation went perfect which was done through Costco's third party.

With dimensions of 555 x 450 x 500mm, it is quite large, providing ample space for dishes. I like that there are various cycles; I recommend the Powerful mode. It cleans dishes squeaky clean even with a lot of grease. Since it is a countertop model, I like that I can use it without bending over. It is not loud, so it is fine to run it at night. My personal tip: If installation is difficult due to lack of space, purchase a sink extension plate. You can save water by filling the drain hose with water and using it for a pre-wash. Attaching the hose to a transparent mop holder is better than using a suction cup, so it stays in place better. Attaching a refrigerator magnetic shelf to the side of the dishwasher and placing the dishwasher detergent dispenser there makes the workflow much more convenient! Place a silicone mat on top of the dishwasher to dry any remaining moisture after removing the dishes. Overall Review: I am so glad I bought this that I wonder why I didn't purchase it sooner. My biggest dilemma was the size, so I was debating between the 14-person and 6-person models. They say "bigger is better" when it comes to appliances, so I was worried the capacity might be small, but large woks, pots, and pans fit perfectly inside. It is big, but the design is pretty. I chose beige because I thought white might look too plain, and beige is lovely too! I recommend it.

It's disheartening the consumer carries the load for everything these days, paying so much money for everything and getting so little in return. Sigh…. I'll give another review after the appliance is installed. But, I thought this might give perspective to someone before they decide to buy. And the rebate is helpful, even though you have to spend time looking for it, submitting and tracking it. Sentence (English): I deliberated over which dishwasher to buy before purchasing the largest size, and I am extremely satisfied.
Comments (English): [ A must-have item that instantly boosts housework efficiency ] || ---------------- || I deliberated over which dishwasher to buy before purchasing the largest size, and I am extremely satisfied. Since it is a 14-place setting model, I am most pleased that it fits pots and large plates with plenty of room to spare. I chose the Essential White color, which matches the kitchen's atmosphere cleanly. As it is a built-in model, it doesn't stand out and looks neat and tidy after installation, so I think it blends in well. The cleaning performance was also better than expected. Even dishes with rice residue or grease are mostly cleaned thoroughly with the basic cycle, and bulky items like pots and pans fit perfectly if arranged properly. The upper and lower basket configuration is more practical than I thought, making it easy to load dishes all at once. The hot air drying function works quite well as well. Of course, there are times when a little water remains in areas where water tends to pool, like the bottom of cups, but overall, it has significantly reduced the hassle of having to wash dishes by hand, which has greatly improved my quality of life. Installation was handled via Rocket Installation, and the technician briefly explained the installation location and how to use it, so it wasn't difficult even for a first-time user. Overall, although it is on the pricier side, the satisfaction of saving dishwashing time is so great that I feel I made a good purchase. Highly recommended!
Comments (Original): [ 집안일 한끝 효율 높여준 꿀템 ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기 고민하다가 제일 큰사이즈로 구매했는데 결론은 대만족이에요. 14인용이라 냄비나 큰 접시까지 넉넉하게 들어가는 점이 가장 만족스러워요.색상은 에센셜화이트로 선택했는데 주방 분위기랑 깔끔하게 잘 어울리고, 빌트인 제품이라 설치 후에도 튀지 않고 정돈된 느낌이 나서 잘 어울리는 것 같아요.세척력도 기대 이상이었어요. 밥풀이나 기름기 있는 그릇도 기본 코스로 돌리면 대부분 깨끗하게 세척되고, 냄비나 프라이팬처럼 부피가 있는 식기도 배치만 잘하면 충분히 들어가요. 상단·하단 바구니 구성도 생각보다 실용적이라 식기 한 번에 넣기 좋았어요.열풍건조 기능도 꽤 잘 되는 편아에요. 물론 컵 바닥처럼 물이 고일 수 있는 부분은 약간 남을 때도 있지만, 전체적으로는 손으로 따로 닦아야 하는 번거로움이 많이 줄어서 생활의질을 많이 개선시킨 것 같아요설치는 로켓설치로 진행됐고, 기사님이 설치 위치와 사용 방법도 간단히 설명해주셔서 처음 사용하는 입장에서도 어렵지 않았어요.전체적으로 가격대는 있지만 설거지 시간을 줄여주는 만족도가 커서 잘 샀다는 생각이 들어요. 강추!!

Is it the detergent's fault? ] || ---------------- || "A product that was working perfectly fine for a month suddenly leaks, but they blame the detergent? I am exposing the absurd response from Coupang's home appliance service." This is a brand-new product purchased from Coupang for 370,000 won just one month and one week ago. 1. An analysis of the cause that defies common sense. The product had been working perfectly without any issues for a month using the same detergent for 6 servings. However, recently, water suddenly started leaking from the bottom, so I requested after-sales service. In response, the technician gave an absurd answer, stating, "Workshop tests showed no defects in the unit itself," and advising me to "cut the 6-serving detergent in half and use it for 3 servings because this model is a slim 2-tier type with a narrow base." It would be understandable if there had been a problem from the beginning, but how can a product that was used perfectly fine with the standard 6-serving amount for a month suddenly start leaking be considered a problem with the amount of detergent rather than a device defect? 2. Irresponsible solutions that deceive consumers and insulting customer service. Although I was frustrated and dumbfounded, I did confirm that the water did not leak when I cut the detergent in half and put it in, as the technician suggested. However, concluding that "there is no defect in the product" based on this is a clear evasion of responsibility by the manufacturer and the service center. How can it be considered a normal product when I purchased one designed for 6 people but have to split the detergent in half every time to use it as if it were for 3 people? Furthermore, the technician directly made a statement that defied common sense, saying, **"There were no issues when we tested it, but since you contacted us again just a day after we picked it up because it was leaking, we thought you were making a fuss among ourselves."** I was extremely displeased and upset by the fact that they internally dismissed a customer's legitimate complaint regarding a device defect as "making a fuss" and branded me as a "black consumer." Although I eventually received an apology from the technician after strongly protesting, I was deeply hurt by his attitude of treating me as a potential troublemaker. 3. Broken Trust and a Sense of Injustice. Ultimately, because the technician refused to acknowledge the device defect, I was unable to receive proper repair or exchange services, even though I had purchased a new product worth 370,000 won. I feel incredibly wronged and indignant that a consumer must bear the full burden of such inconvenience and financial loss. This incident has completely shattered my trust in Coupang's appliance installation service and after-sales support. I do not think I will be able to purchase any electronic products or receive service from Coupang with peace of mind in the future. I express my strong regret over this irresponsible service, which tarnishes the reputation of a major corporation.

Sentence (English): I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking!
Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. However, thanks to the automatic opening feature, it dries over time. With silicone dishes, water stains remain even after using rinse aid, making them difficult to use. This is the only slightly disappointing aspect, but it didn't significantly impact my overall satisfaction. One-month usage review! I debated whether to buy a smaller one or the 14-place setting model, but I love that it's big! It has three tiers; it fits perfectly if you put a couple of large items like pots on the bottom tier, main dishes and cups on the middle tier, and cooking utensils and cutlery on the top! We are a family of four (one toddler eating solid food, one on formula), and since we don't eat breakfast, we mostly gather the dishes and run the wash cycle once a day after dinner. Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time. If you have multiple children, you absolutely must buy this!

Sentence (English): It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! *
Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. However, thanks to the automatic opening feature, it dries over time. With silicone dishes, water stains remain even after using rinse aid, making them difficult to use. This is the only slightly disappointing aspect, but it didn't significantly impact my overall satisfaction. One-month usage review! I debated whether to buy a smaller one or the 14-place setting model, but I love that it's big! We are a family of four (one toddler eating solid food, one on formula), and since we don't eat breakfast, we mostly gather the dishes and run the wash cycle once a day after dinner. Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time. If you have multiple children, you absolutely must buy this!

Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. This is the only slightly disappointing aspect, but it didn't significantly impact my overall satisfaction. One-month usage review! I debated whether to buy a smaller one or the 14-place setting model, but I love that it's big! Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time. If you have multiple children, you absolutely must buy this!

Sentence (English): With silicone dishes, water stains remain even after using rinse aid, making them difficult to use.
Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. However, thanks to the automatic opening feature, it dries over time. With silicone dishes, water stains remain even after using rinse aid, making them difficult to use. This is the only slightly disappointing aspect, but it didn't significantly impact my overall satisfaction. One-month usage review! I debated whether to buy a smaller one or the 14-place setting model, but I love that it's big! It has three tiers; it fits perfectly if you put a couple of large items like pots on the bottom tier, main dishes and cups on the middle tier, and cooking utensils and cutlery on the top! We are a family of four (one toddler eating solid food, one on formula), and since we don't eat breakfast, we mostly gather the dishes and run the wash cycle once a day after dinner. Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time. If you have multiple children, you absolutely must buy this!

Sentence (English): One-month usage review!
Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. However, thanks to the automatic opening feature, it dries over time. With silicone dishes, water stains remain even after using rinse aid, making them difficult to use. This is the only slightly disappointing aspect, but it didn't significantly impact my overall satisfaction. One-month usage review! I debated whether to buy a smaller one or the 14-place setting model, but I love that it's big! It has three tiers; it fits perfectly if you put a couple of large items like pots on the bottom tier, main dishes and cups on the middle tier, and cooking utensils and cutlery on the top! We are a family of four (one toddler eating solid food, one on formula), and since we don't eat breakfast, we mostly gather the dishes and run the wash cycle once a day after dinner. Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time. If you have multiple children, you absolutely must buy this!

Sentence (English): We are a family of four (one toddler eating solid food, one on formula), and since we don't eat breakfast, we mostly gather the dishes and run the wash cycle once a day after dinner.
Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Sentence (English): Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time.
Comments (English): * Reason for Use: As parenting increased the amount of dishes to wash and I lacked time, I purchased this when I moved. It has definitely reduced dishwashing time, significantly easing the burden of housework! * Product Features and User Experience: The cleaning power is better than I expected! I don't pre-wash with detergent; I just rinse off most of the food residue with water before putting the dishes in, and they are cleaned thoroughly without any foreign matter. It is so convenient to have it connected to the Samsung SmartThings app! The dishwasher has a wide variety of modes, making it great to use according to the situation. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, and since I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, I don't feel intimidated when cooking! The feature I am most satisfied with is the bottle sterilization mode. It reduces the hassle of sterilizing bottles or baby dishes separately, making it really useful for households with young children! * Pros: - Dishwashing time has been significantly reduced, definitely improving quality of life. - The bottle sterilization mode makes it highly useful for households with young children. - The electricity bill was not much different than I worried about before using it, so it was a less burdensome cost. - Maintenance is also easier than I expected. * Cons: Although it has a powerful drying function, some moisture sometimes remains on plastic or concave dishes. However, thanks to the automatic opening feature, it dries over time. With silicone dishes, water stains remain even after using rinse aid, making them difficult to use. This is the only slightly disappointing aspect, but it didn't significantly impact my overall satisfaction. One-month usage review! I debated whether to buy a smaller one or the 14-place setting model, but I love that it's big! It has three tiers; it fits perfectly if you put a couple of large items like pots on the bottom tier, main dishes and cups on the middle tier, and cooking utensils and cutlery on the top! We are a family of four (one toddler eating solid food, one on formula), and since we don't eat breakfast, we mostly gather the dishes and run the wash cycle once a day after dinner. Because of the automatic opening feature, the door opens by itself, so the dishes are completely dry by the next morning, making it perfect for organizing in the morning! When I moved in after redecorating, I was worried that the white color might stand out too much against the wood tones, but it isn't jarring and doesn't ruin the interior, which is great. Recommended for: I think this is a highly satisfying appliance for families with young children or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing time. If you have multiple children, you absolutely must buy this!

Sentence (English): It's been a week since I installed it and I use it daily.
Comments (English): [ excellent tool ] || ---------------- || It's been a week since I installed it and I use it daily. I put everything together and wash it before going to bed. I really like it. We installed a dedicated circuit breaker because of voltage fluctuations, and we still need to get a voltage regulator. This model includes the electrical connection, unlike the built-in models that require a separate connection. It doesn't include the plumbing kit (water inlet), only the drain hose, which is already attached. I bought an extension because my drain was far away, and it worked perfectly. In total, it's about 3 meters long, and everything is fine! This model has a salt reservoir, and you can adjust the amount of salt depending on the water hardness in your area. It comes with a water hardness test strip, and you program the salt to use for each wash based on that reading (the salt is specifically for dishwashers; I bought a 5-kilo container). It has a cutlery basket, an adjustable-height upper rack, and a large lower rack. So far, I'm very happy with it.

Sentence (English): Very disappointed in my KitchenAid products.
Comments (English): [ Not designed for long life ] || ---------------- || Very disappointed in my KitchenAid products. My first KitchenAid dishwasher failed just after first year. I was on business trip and told wife to buy same unit again. I told her “KitchenAid is known for quality products and this failure must have been a fluke”. Second unit quite before end of second year. Wash motor failed when the integrated Self-Cleaning Filter failed and jammed motor. Doing some research, this appears to be a common failure. My wife and I preclean our dishes before going into dishwasher. This filter was never heavily loaded and should not have failed as early as it did. Have family coming into town this week and cant wait on ordering parts. Moving on to another brand at this point. KitchenAid doesn't make Consumer Reports “recommended buy”. Will be looking at Bosch or LG.

Sentence (English): If you are looking for a dishwasher that delivers flawlessly spotless results and runs so silently you'll forget it's even on, the Bosch Benchmark is worth every penny.
Comments (English): [ A Must-Have for Open-Concept Living ] || ---------------- || If you are looking for a dishwasher that delivers flawlessly spotless results and runs so silently you'll forget it's even on, the Bosch Benchmark is worth every penny. 1. The Ultimate Test: Open-Concept Silence Our kitchen opens directly into the main living area, meaning the dishwasher sits essentially right next to the TV. In an open-concept design, noise level isn't just a specification—it's a lifestyle factor. The Benchmark is completely unnoticeable. It washes thoroughly without ever competing with the TV or family conversation. It does its job entirely in the background. 2. Spotless Performance (From Hard Water to Soft) Having previously lived in Southern California, I spent years fighting stubborn hard water film and spots. I tried premium dishwashers from multiple brands—including GE Profile—and found that only the Bosch family (including Thermador) could actually handle the job. Now, using the Benchmark in Vancouver's soft water ecosystem, the performance is flawless. Dishes, cutlery, and glassware come out completely pristine and spotless every single time. 3. The Truth About the "Drying Issue" Before purchasing, I read online complaints from users claiming Bosch dishwashers leave dishes damp or struggle with drying. That has not been my experience at all. Everything comes out bone-dry and ready to be put away immediately. The high-end drying technology in this unit completely solves the traditional complaints associated with European condensation drying. Final Thoughts For anyone who prioritizes clean, spotless dishes and needs an appliance quiet enough for a shared living and kitchen space, I cannot recommend the Bosch Benchmark enough. It is the only dishwasher line I recommend.

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Since moving in, I've run everything from kitchen tools and dishes to pots and pans—I used it like crazy. At first, I was like, "Huh?" but eventually, I just left it running and went to sleep. Stacking is difficult and my back hurts, but since I spend less time standing doing dishes, my soles hurt less. I saw reviews saying that even though it has a hot air drying function, people don't use it much. Hmm, I think I'll buy the next model that has hot air. It's not nearly perfect drying, but it's a shame that things like baby bottles don't dry well when put in upside down. Anyway, thank you for the affordable price and the Onnuri refund.
Comments (Original): 식세기 처음 써보는데, 이사와서 키친툴이며 그릇, 냄비, 후라이팬 전부 돌렸어요ㅋㅋ 미친듯이 썼네요.처음엔 읭?하는데 나중엔 그냥 돌려놓고 자고 그랬어요ㅋ쌓기가 어렵고 허리도 아프지만 설거지 한다고 서있는 시간 줄어서 발바닥이 덜 아프네요.열풍건조가 있어도 잘 안 쓴다는 리뷰봤는데음, 저는 다음 모델은 열풍 있는 걸로 살 것 같아요완벽에 가까운 건조는 아니어도 젖병같은거 엎어서 넣으니 물이 잘 안 말라서 아쉽거든요~무튼, 저렴한 가격에 온누리 환급까지 감사합니다.

Comments (English): [ This is an honest review of the Samsung 14-place setting dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || The no-name dishwasher I was using in the kitchen kept breaking down and giving me so much trouble, so I decided to take this opportunity to completely replace it and purchased a product from a major brand. After clearing out the junk and bringing in a gleaming new machine, I painfully realized that when it comes to appliances, you really have to buy one that lives up to its name. Delivery was incredibly fast; it arrived just two to three days after ordering. The installation technician was also very quick, adjusting everything perfectly, and the whole process took roughly 30 minutes to an hour. After installation, they kindly connected the dishwasher to Wi-Fi and set up the app on my phone, and even completed a thorough test run, so I was very comfortable without having to worry about internet connectivity. There is one thing I really want to emphasize to those considering purchasing this: inspecting the base cabinet beforehand. I skipped the pre-inspection assuming the size would fit since it was where my previous dishwasher was, but this was a huge mistake. The model I bought did not come with a baseboard attached by default, so I ended up using it with the bottom completely exposed. Even if it is a hassle, I strongly recommend that you have the installation team thoroughly check for the presence of baseboards and complete the pre-installation work. By far, my favorite feature of this product is the AI customization function. In the past, I used to worry about which cycle to choose every time based on the soiling level of the dishes, but now the machine automatically analyzes the situation and adjusts the water temperature and time. Since it runs automatically just by turning on the power and pressing the start button, I am completely freed from the worry of washing dishes. If you are considering a dishwasher or find setting it up a hassle, I strongly recommend buying one that includes the AI customization function. The interior space is also very generous, accommodating 14 people, making it perfect for washing a day's worth of pots and dishes all at once. The pins inside that hold the dishes can be folded and unfolded in sections; although it felt a bit awkward at first—like assembling Lego—I got used to it quickly. In particular, being able to adjust the height of the middle shelf as I please is incredibly satisfying; I can raise the shelf high and stack bulky pots or large frying pans on the bottom rack. Compared to the days when the machine gave me a headache due to breakdowns, this is truly heaven—it does everything automatically with just the push of a button. I highly recommend her as a truly reliable kitchen helper who brings convenience to your daily life.

Comments (English): [ This is an honest review of the Samsung 14-place setting dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || The no-name dishwasher I was using in the kitchen kept breaking down and giving me so much trouble, so I decided to take this opportunity to completely replace it and purchased a product from a major brand. After clearing out the junk and bringing in a gleaming new machine, I painfully realized that when it comes to appliances, you really have to buy one that lives up to its name. Delivery was incredibly fast; it arrived just two to three days after ordering. The installation technician was also very quick, adjusting everything perfectly, and the whole process took roughly 30 minutes to an hour. After installation, they kindly connected the dishwasher to Wi-Fi and set up the app on my phone, and even completed a thorough test run, so I was very comfortable without having to worry about internet connectivity. There is one thing I really want to emphasize to those considering purchasing this: inspecting the base cabinet beforehand. I skipped the pre-inspection assuming the size would fit since it was where my previous dishwasher was, but this was a huge mistake. The model I bought did not come with a baseboard attached by default, so I ended up using it with the bottom completely exposed. Even if it is a hassle, I strongly recommend that you have the installation team thoroughly check for the presence of baseboards and complete the pre-installation work. By far, my favorite feature of this product is the AI customization function. In the past, I used to worry about which cycle to choose every time based on the soiling level of the dishes, but now the machine automatically analyzes the situation and adjusts the water temperature and time. Since it runs automatically just by turning on the power and pressing the start button, I am completely freed from the worry of washing dishes. If you are considering a dishwasher or find setting it up a hassle, I strongly recommend buying one that includes the AI customization function. The interior space is also very generous, accommodating 14 people, making it perfect for washing a day's worth of pots and dishes all at once. The pins inside that hold the dishes can be folded and unfolded in sections; although it felt a bit awkward at first—like assembling Lego—I got used to it quickly. In particular, being able to adjust the height of the middle shelf as I please is incredibly satisfying; I can raise the shelf high and stack bulky pots or large frying pans on the bottom rack. Compared to the days when the machine gave me a headache due to breakdowns, this is truly heaven—it does everything automatically with just the push of a button. I highly recommend her as a truly reliable kitchen helper who brings convenience to your daily life.

If you are considering a dishwasher or find setting it up a hassle, I strongly recommend buying one that includes the AI customization function. The interior space is also very generous, accommodating 14 people, making it perfect for washing a day's worth of pots and dishes all at once. The pins inside that hold the dishes can be folded and unfolded in sections; although it felt a bit awkward at first—like assembling Lego—I got used to it quickly. In particular, being able to adjust the height of the middle shelf as I please is incredibly satisfying; I can raise the shelf high and stack bulky pots or large frying pans on the bottom rack. Compared to the days when the machine gave me a headache due to breakdowns, this is truly heaven—it does everything automatically with just the push of a button. I highly recommend her as a truly reliable kitchen helper who brings convenience to your daily life.

These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price.
