Sentence (English): Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation.
Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Comments (English): I worked hard to earn this myself and bought it with my own money! I want to let you know that this is an honest review intended to be helpful to other customers. These days, washing dishes seems to be the most time-consuming chore of the house. Seeing the dishes pile up several times a day, I often thought how nice it would be to have a dishwasher. After much consideration, the product I chose was the Samsung Electronics dishwasher. The exact model is the BESPOKE AI Dishwasher Built-in 12-Place Capacity, Essential White, DW80F71Y1UEWS, with on-site installation. Since it is a built-in type, it fits neatly into the kitchen, and with a 12-place capacity, it was convenient to fit family dishes, pots, cups, and plates all at once. My first impression when I received the product was its clean and simple design. Because it is the Essential White color, the kitchen doesn't look cramped, and true to the Samsung BESPOKE line, it has a strong overall clean feel. Once installed in the kitchen, it didn't stand out as much as I expected and blended naturally with the interior, so I was satisfied. While researching dishwashers, I compared several different brands. Considering the price range, capacity, design, and features, I felt that the Samsung dishwasher was the most reliable choice. In particular, its large 12-place setting capacity makes it suitable for a family of 3 to 4 people, and it was convenient to gather the day's dishes and run them all at once. There were three main reasons for my choice: the large 12-place setting capacity allows for washing the entire family's dishes at once; the built-in installation keeps the kitchen looking neat; and the steam soak, powerful wash, and automatic door opening drying functions are excellent for practical use. The aspect I was most satisfied with while using it was its cleaning power. Even dishes with slightly burnt-on rice or sauce stains finished much cleaner than expected after using the steam soak function to loosen them. Perhaps because of the design where water jets come from both the bottom and top, it cleaned corners and concave dishes quite well. I also liked the automatic door opening drying feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes, and the dishes felt much less damp than when washed by hand. Of course, there were instances where a little water remained depending on the material or arrangement of the dishes, but overall, I am satisfied. The operation method was also not difficult. At first, it seemed like there were many cycles, but after using it a few times, I found myself sticking to the ones I use most frequently. Features like a low-noise cycle and extra rinses were also great, allowing me to choose the appropriate one depending on the situation. The shelf height is adjustable, which was more convenient than expected when loading large pots or deep dishes. Since it is a product requiring professional installation, the installation process was also convenient. I was worried about the installation because it is a built-in unit, but the technician came to check the location and installed it for me, so I didn't have to do any complicated work myself. Installation feasibility may vary depending on the sink structure, so I think it is essential to check the installation space before trying it out. I would particularly recommend the Samsung dishwasher to the following people: families of 3 to 4 people; those who want to reduce dishwashing time; those who want to keep their kitchen tidy with a built-in design; those who prefer a white-toned kitchen interior; and those considering their first dishwasher experience. If I had to point out a drawback, it took a little time at first to get the hang of how to arrange the dishes for them to be cleaned properly. Also, you have to bring dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid separately, so I recommend that first-time users prepare these as well. Nevertheless, after using it for a few days, I was quite satisfied because the time spent washing dishes by hand was drastically reduced. Overall, I think the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting) is a well-balanced product in terms of design, capacity, cleaning power, and ease of installation. Since the stress of washing dishes has decreased, the burden of kitchen work has definitely lightened. I felt it was a pretty good choice if you consider it an appliance you will use for a long time rather than just looking at the price. Sentence (English): My dishwashing stress has truly disappeared.
Comments (English): My dishwashing stress has truly disappeared. The most satisfying aspect is that I no longer have to spend time on washing dishes. Since I can simply put the dishes in after a meal and press a button, I no longer have to stand in front of the sink every evening. As a 14-place setting that comfortably fits pots, pans, plates, and cups all at once, I was able to use it leisurely even after family meals. The cleaning power exceeded my expectations. Even greasy pans and dishes stained with sauce were cleaned thoroughly. I was most satisfied with how it cleaned even the parts that are cumbersome to wipe by hand, such as the inside of cups, chopsticks, and cutlery. Since it was washed with hot water, I felt reassured knowing that it was being maintained hygienically. The hot air drying performance is excellent. The biggest reason I chose this product was the hot air drying function, and it exceeded my expectations. Once drying was complete, most dishes were finished cleanly with almost no moisture, making them ready for immediate storage. In particular, glass cups and stainless steel dishes seemed to regain their shine, making them feel even cleaner than when washed by hand. The AI features and low noise levels are also satisfying. The AI customized washing function, which automatically adjusts the course according to the condition of the dishes, was very convenient. It was easy to operate and the touch interface made it very user-friendly. Above all, the noise during operation was quieter than expected, allowing me to use it without worry even in the evening or at night. It was quiet enough that it didn't even stand out much when placed in the living room. The design also blends well with the interior. The clean Bespoke Essential White color made the kitchen atmosphere look much more luxurious. Since it is a built-in unit, it blends naturally with the kitchen furniture without protruding, making the space look much larger. Those redecorating their kitchen will likely find the design satisfaction quite high. The installation service was also satisfactory. The technician meticulously checked the location and piping before installation, and after installation, explained in detail how to use it, how to add detergent, and maintenance tips. It was great that they kindly guided me so that even a first-time dishwasher user could operate it without difficulty. Areas for Improvement. If I had to point out a drawback, it would be that you need to be a little careful with space utilization depending on how you load large pots or pans. Also, while arranging the dishes required a bit of knack at first, I quickly got used to it after using it for a few days. I think this is something that anyone who uses a dishwasher will naturally adapt to. Overall Impression. After using it, I immediately understood why dishwashers are called "quality-of-life appliances." I am very satisfied because reducing dishwashing time gives me extra time, and it feels more hygienic than washing by hand. Overall, it is a high-quality product in terms of cleaning power, drying performance, design, and convenience. I believe it would be even more satisfying for dual-income couples or families with children. Although the price might be a bit steep, I believe it is well worth the cost once you use it, and I am satisfied enough to purchase the same product again.

They are college students, not working adults yet, but they told me they were saving up their allowance little by little to buy it for me. Honestly, I thought about it a lot. I hadn't even considered it because I realized how convenient it is to wash dishes immediately. But then, after looking around here and there, I changed my mind a bit, wondering if it might actually be convenient. Then, my kids said that it would be good to have one because they also find washing dishes a hassle when I'm sick or not home. Honestly, I think the downside of a dishwasher is that you have to let things pile up before you can wash them. You have to let them soak for a while and then put them all in at once to save on water and electricity bills. But honestly, I heard that using a dishwasher actually saves on electricity and water bills. After much deliberation, I decided to accept what my kids bought for me. It arrived today, and I'm using it for the first time. Since earlier today, I've been putting the dishes in little by little to pre-wash them. And I'm running everything at once right now after dinner. Saving up to do things doesn't really suit my personality, but it's so nice to run it all at once and not have to do the dinner dishes. It also gives me some extra time. It's only my first day, but I'm satisfied; it's convenient and great.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher itself is excellent.
Comments (English): [ Five-Star Dishwasher, One-Star Installation ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher itself is excellent. It cleans well and is incredibly quiet—I often have to check the indicator light to confirm that it's running. If I were reviewing the appliance alone, I would give it 5 stars. Unfortunately, my experience with Home Depot's installation service was very disappointing. The dishwasher was not properly leveled, the toe plate was not initially installed, and the wiring from my previous hardwired dishwasher was not properly addressed. After reporting these issues, I was told that a senior installation technician would be sent to resolve them. Instead, the same technicians who performed the original installation returned. When they left, the dishwasher still was not properly leveled, the exposed wiring remained unaddressed, and the newly installed toe plate prevented the dishwasher door from fully opening. I ultimately had to remove the toe plate myself in order to use the dishwasher. I also contacted Home Depot's Resolutions Escalation Team expecting assistance in resolving the installation issues. Instead, the primary option presented was to schedule a pickup of the dishwasher. Given the ongoing installation concerns and lack of resolution, that is exactly what I chose to do. Ironically, I found the exact same dishwasher elsewhere for significantly less than I paid at Home Depot. The dishwasher itself is outstanding and deserves high marks. However, my installation and customer service experience fell far below expectations. Based on my experience, I would strongly recommend considering alternative installation options rather than Home Depot's installation service. Bottom line: Great dishwasher. Poor installation experience. More aggravation than it was worth.

It cleans well and is incredibly quiet—I often have to check the indicator light to confirm that it's running. If I were reviewing the appliance alone, I would give it 5 stars. Unfortunately, my experience with Home Depot's installation service was very disappointing. The dishwasher was not properly leveled, the toe plate was not initially installed, and the wiring from my previous hardwired dishwasher was not properly addressed. After reporting these issues, I was told that a senior installation technician would be sent to resolve them. Instead, the same technicians who performed the original installation returned. When they left, the dishwasher still was not properly leveled, the exposed wiring remained unaddressed, and the newly installed toe plate prevented the dishwasher door from fully opening. I ultimately had to remove the toe plate myself in order to use the dishwasher. I also contacted Home Depot's Resolutions Escalation Team expecting assistance in resolving the installation issues. Instead, the primary option presented was to schedule a pickup of the dishwasher. Given the ongoing installation concerns and lack of resolution, that is exactly what I chose to do. Ironically, I found the exact same dishwasher elsewhere for significantly less than I paid at Home Depot. The dishwasher itself is outstanding and deserves high marks. However, my installation and customer service experience fell far below expectations. Based on my experience, I would strongly recommend considering alternative installation options rather than Home Depot's installation service. Bottom line: Great dishwasher. Poor installation experience. More aggravation than it was worth.

Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. Samsung 6-Place Dishwasher. To start with the conclusion, I understand why everyone calls dishwashers "quality-of-life appliances." At first, I was worried that a 6-place setting might be too small, but for a 1-2 person household, it was actually quite spacious. It fits rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all at once, and being able to clean up the dishes that pile up after meals immediately has made things much more convenient. The most satisfying aspect is definitely the reduction in time spent on hand washing. I was particularly pleased that even greasy or sauce-stained dishes came out clean after washing. Since I can just rinse them roughly with water, put them in, and run the cycle, my dishwashing stress has really decreased. The automatic door opening feature was also more useful than I expected; the door opens after the wash is finished, allowing internal moisture to escape and reducing the musty feeling on the dishes. The design is also clean, so it blends in well without standing out in the kitchen. The noise wasn't as loud as I had feared, so I didn't mind running it in the evening. Of course, it isn't completely silent, but it wasn't loud enough to be bothersome during daily life. There are some downsides, though. Since it is a 6-person capacity, it is a bit difficult to fit large pots or frying pans all at once, and the cleaning results sometimes varied depending on how the dishes were arranged. At first, I felt that some stacking technique was required. Sentence (English): We purchased this Bosch 500 Series to replace a well loved Bosch 800 Series that had given us about 14 years of worry free service in a very hard water environment.
Comments (English): [ Love hate relationship ] || ---------------- || We purchased this Bosch 500 Series to replace a well loved Bosch 800 Series that had given us about 14 years of worry free service in a very hard water environment. Our love/hate relationship started upon installation when I found I had to go to the hardware store to purchase an elbow to connect the water line. Why it wasn't includes boggles my mind. After it was installed I went to start it and nothing we tried on the control panel would get the bugger going. As a last ditch effort I loaded the Bosch app on my phone, turned on remote start and from that point on everything worked. Very odd. The dishwasher does an excellent job cleaning our dishes. However a few things really bother me. First the silverware basket was half the size of the one from my old 800 Series, so we kept the old basket from that. Silverware on the top drawer? Ridiculous. The absolute worst thing about the 500 Series is the middle drawer. There's very few tines to seperate items, sorta free form city. We use a lot of long stemmed wine glasses and if we use the fold down stem holders it pretty much takes up two rows, the rightmost under the wine glasses is rendered almost useless (see photo). We love how quiet it is, how well it cleans our dishware, but absolutely hate the middle drawer!

Sentence (English): My old dishwasher suddenly broke down, causing me some trouble for a while before I finally decided to buy a new one.
Comments (English): [ An honest review of the dishwasher, an essential appliance that delivers a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling ] || ---------------- || My old dishwasher suddenly broke down, causing me some trouble for a while before I finally decided to buy a new one. Since this product is a freestanding model, it fits neatly into a corner of the kitchen without any complicated installation, so I had absolutely no burden regarding installation. I am extremely satisfied with the actual product. First off, the bright Nature Beige color looks luxurious and absolutely beautiful. It brightens up the kitchen tone, making it a truly valuable interior appliance. In particular, the interior lighting feature, which illuminates brightly when you open the door, is truly a stroke of genius! It is incredibly convenient to load and unload dishes because you can see deep inside clearly, even late at night or without turning on the kitchen lights. Zero water stains thanks to the water softening system. One of the decisive reasons I chose this model was precisely this water softening function. If you place dishwasher-specific salt into the dedicated slot, it perfectly filters out limescale from the water. Thanks to this, dishes, clear glass cups, and spoons gleam after washing without any water stains. The difference in clarity makes me feel good every time I take them out. Large capacity of 14 place settings and practical storage shelves. When the foldable rack on the bottom shelf is folded, even bulky frying pans or deep pots fit easily inside. On days with many dishes, you can simply stand the rack up again, allowing for customized space utilization depending on your needs, which is really great. I am particularly satisfied with the dedicated storage space provided to securely hold knives and scissors. The top cutlery shelf is height-adjustable to the left and right, making it efficient to fit and rotate large cooking tools, such as thick ladles and tongs, all at once without having to play Tetris. I could feel that every corner of the shelf perfectly reflected the needs of a homemaker. Review: Due to a sudden breakdown, I had no choice but to do hand dishes for a month until a new dishwasher arrived. It was a complete disaster. I couldn't even imagine cleaning up after cooking, and the inconvenience of having to waste my precious rest time in front of the sink after work was immense. With just the press of a single button, the dishwasher sterilizes at high temperature and removes even stubborn stains, and the automatic door-opening drying finishes everything perfectly on its own. I realized once again that a dishwasher is an absolute must-have appliance for every kitchen. It is also incredibly quiet, so I don't feel any burden at all running it at night. Final review: It is an essential appliance that provides a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling that is absolutely impossible with hand washing. I strongly recommend it without hesitation to those who were hesitant about installing a freestanding unit because built-in was difficult, or to those stressed about water stains on glass cups. My quality of life has skyrocketed again! It is the best appliance I have ever bought with my own money.

Comments (English): [ An honest review of the dishwasher, an essential appliance that delivers a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling ] || ---------------- || My old dishwasher suddenly broke down, causing me some trouble for a while before I finally decided to buy a new one. Since this product is a freestanding model, it fits neatly into a corner of the kitchen without any complicated installation, so I had absolutely no burden regarding installation. I am extremely satisfied with the actual product. First off, the bright Nature Beige color looks luxurious and absolutely beautiful. It brightens up the kitchen tone, making it a truly valuable interior appliance. In particular, the interior lighting feature, which illuminates brightly when you open the door, is truly a stroke of genius! It is incredibly convenient to load and unload dishes because you can see deep inside clearly, even late at night or without turning on the kitchen lights. Zero water stains thanks to the water softening system. One of the decisive reasons I chose this model was precisely this water softening function. If you place dishwasher-specific salt into the dedicated slot, it perfectly filters out limescale from the water. Thanks to this, dishes, clear glass cups, and spoons gleam after washing without any water stains. The difference in clarity makes me feel good every time I take them out. Large capacity of 14 place settings and practical storage shelves. When the foldable rack on the bottom shelf is folded, even bulky frying pans or deep pots fit easily inside. On days with many dishes, you can simply stand the rack up again, allowing for customized space utilization depending on your needs, which is really great. I am particularly satisfied with the dedicated storage space provided to securely hold knives and scissors. The top cutlery shelf is height-adjustable to the left and right, making it efficient to fit and rotate large cooking tools, such as thick ladles and tongs, all at once without having to play Tetris. I could feel that every corner of the shelf perfectly reflected the needs of a homemaker. Review: Due to a sudden breakdown, I had no choice but to do hand dishes for a month until a new dishwasher arrived. It was a complete disaster. I couldn't even imagine cleaning up after cooking, and the inconvenience of having to waste my precious rest time in front of the sink after work was immense. With just the press of a single button, the dishwasher sterilizes at high temperature and removes even stubborn stains, and the automatic door-opening drying finishes everything perfectly on its own. I realized once again that a dishwasher is an absolute must-have appliance for every kitchen. It is also incredibly quiet, so I don't feel any burden at all running it at night. Final review: It is an essential appliance that provides a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling that is absolutely impossible with hand washing. I strongly recommend it without hesitation to those who were hesitant about installing a freestanding unit because built-in was difficult, or to those stressed about water stains on glass cups. My quality of life has skyrocketed again! It is the best appliance I have ever bought with my own money.

Since this product is a freestanding model, it fits neatly into a corner of the kitchen without any complicated installation, so I had absolutely no burden regarding installation. I am extremely satisfied with the actual product. First off, the bright Nature Beige color looks luxurious and absolutely beautiful. It brightens up the kitchen tone, making it a truly valuable interior appliance. In particular, the interior lighting feature, which illuminates brightly when you open the door, is truly a stroke of genius! It is incredibly convenient to load and unload dishes because you can see deep inside clearly, even late at night or without turning on the kitchen lights. Zero water stains thanks to the water softening system. One of the decisive reasons I chose this model was precisely this water softening function. If you place dishwasher-specific salt into the dedicated slot, it perfectly filters out limescale from the water. Thanks to this, dishes, clear glass cups, and spoons gleam after washing without any water stains. The difference in clarity makes me feel good every time I take them out. Large capacity of 14 place settings and practical storage shelves. When the foldable rack on the bottom shelf is folded, even bulky frying pans or deep pots fit easily inside. On days with many dishes, you can simply stand the rack up again, allowing for customized space utilization depending on your needs, which is really great. I am particularly satisfied with the dedicated storage space provided to securely hold knives and scissors. The top cutlery shelf is height-adjustable to the left and right, making it efficient to fit and rotate large cooking tools, such as thick ladles and tongs, all at once without having to play Tetris. I could feel that every corner of the shelf perfectly reflected the needs of a homemaker. Review: Due to a sudden breakdown, I had no choice but to do hand dishes for a month until a new dishwasher arrived. It was a complete disaster. I couldn't even imagine cleaning up after cooking, and the inconvenience of having to waste my precious rest time in front of the sink after work was immense. With just the press of a single button, the dishwasher sterilizes at high temperature and removes even stubborn stains, and the automatic door-opening drying finishes everything perfectly on its own. I realized once again that a dishwasher is an absolute must-have appliance for every kitchen. It is also incredibly quiet, so I don't feel any burden at all running it at night. Final review: It is an essential appliance that provides a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling that is absolutely impossible with hand washing. I strongly recommend it without hesitation to those who were hesitant about installing a freestanding unit because built-in was difficult, or to those stressed about water stains on glass cups. My quality of life has skyrocketed again! It is the best appliance I have ever bought with my own money.

Comments (English): [ An honest review of the dishwasher, an essential appliance that delivers a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling ] || ---------------- || My old dishwasher suddenly broke down, causing me some trouble for a while before I finally decided to buy a new one. Since this product is a freestanding model, it fits neatly into a corner of the kitchen without any complicated installation, so I had absolutely no burden regarding installation. I am extremely satisfied with the actual product. First off, the bright Nature Beige color looks luxurious and absolutely beautiful. It brightens up the kitchen tone, making it a truly valuable interior appliance. In particular, the interior lighting feature, which illuminates brightly when you open the door, is truly a stroke of genius! It is incredibly convenient to load and unload dishes because you can see deep inside clearly, even late at night or without turning on the kitchen lights. Zero water stains thanks to the water softening system. One of the decisive reasons I chose this model was precisely this water softening function. If you place dishwasher-specific salt into the dedicated slot, it perfectly filters out limescale from the water. Thanks to this, dishes, clear glass cups, and spoons gleam after washing without any water stains. The difference in clarity makes me feel good every time I take them out. Large capacity of 14 place settings and practical storage shelves. When the foldable rack on the bottom shelf is folded, even bulky frying pans or deep pots fit easily inside. On days with many dishes, you can simply stand the rack up again, allowing for customized space utilization depending on your needs, which is really great. I am particularly satisfied with the dedicated storage space provided to securely hold knives and scissors. The top cutlery shelf is height-adjustable to the left and right, making it efficient to fit and rotate large cooking tools, such as thick ladles and tongs, all at once without having to play Tetris. I could feel that every corner of the shelf perfectly reflected the needs of a homemaker. Review: Due to a sudden breakdown, I had no choice but to do hand dishes for a month until a new dishwasher arrived. It was a complete disaster. I couldn't even imagine cleaning up after cooking, and the inconvenience of having to waste my precious rest time in front of the sink after work was immense. With just the press of a single button, the dishwasher sterilizes at high temperature and removes even stubborn stains, and the automatic door-opening drying finishes everything perfectly on its own. I realized once again that a dishwasher is an absolute must-have appliance for every kitchen. It is also incredibly quiet, so I don't feel any burden at all running it at night. Final review: It is an essential appliance that provides a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling that is absolutely impossible with hand washing. I strongly recommend it without hesitation to those who were hesitant about installing a freestanding unit because built-in was difficult, or to those stressed about water stains on glass cups. My quality of life has skyrocketed again! It is the best appliance I have ever bought with my own money.

Since this product is a freestanding model, it fits neatly into a corner of the kitchen without any complicated installation, so I had absolutely no burden regarding installation. I am extremely satisfied with the actual product. First off, the bright Nature Beige color looks luxurious and absolutely beautiful. It brightens up the kitchen tone, making it a truly valuable interior appliance. In particular, the interior lighting feature, which illuminates brightly when you open the door, is truly a stroke of genius! It is incredibly convenient to load and unload dishes because you can see deep inside clearly, even late at night or without turning on the kitchen lights. Zero water stains thanks to the water softening system. One of the decisive reasons I chose this model was precisely this water softening function. If you place dishwasher-specific salt into the dedicated slot, it perfectly filters out limescale from the water. Thanks to this, dishes, clear glass cups, and spoons gleam after washing without any water stains. The difference in clarity makes me feel good every time I take them out. Large capacity of 14 place settings and practical storage shelves. When the foldable rack on the bottom shelf is folded, even bulky frying pans or deep pots fit easily inside. On days with many dishes, you can simply stand the rack up again, allowing for customized space utilization depending on your needs, which is really great. I am particularly satisfied with the dedicated storage space provided to securely hold knives and scissors. The top cutlery shelf is height-adjustable to the left and right, making it efficient to fit and rotate large cooking tools, such as thick ladles and tongs, all at once without having to play Tetris. I could feel that every corner of the shelf perfectly reflected the needs of a homemaker. Review: Due to a sudden breakdown, I had no choice but to do hand dishes for a month until a new dishwasher arrived. It was a complete disaster. I couldn't even imagine cleaning up after cooking, and the inconvenience of having to waste my precious rest time in front of the sink after work was immense. With just the press of a single button, the dishwasher sterilizes at high temperature and removes even stubborn stains, and the automatic door-opening drying finishes everything perfectly on its own. I realized once again that a dishwasher is an absolute must-have appliance for every kitchen. It is also incredibly quiet, so I don't feel any burden at all running it at night. Final review: It is an essential appliance that provides a squeaky clean and refreshing feeling that is absolutely impossible with hand washing. I strongly recommend it without hesitation to those who were hesitant about installing a freestanding unit because built-in was difficult, or to those stressed about water stains on glass cups. My quality of life has skyrocketed again! It is the best appliance I have ever bought with my own money.

We are very loyal Costco customers, have been members more than 20 years. We have bought everything you can think of from Costco, and normally we were satisfied customers. But this has been the absolute worst. We bought this top-of-the-line model thinking it would work great. But it broke down in a few months. At first we didn't worry much, we figured no problem we have warranty, they will fix it or they will replace it if they can't fix whatever is going on. This is where we were wrong. We have made about 40 very unreal calls to Costco and Bosch. Neither is willing to take real responsibility. The people they send to check it out, take forever to schedule a visit and when they do, they keep coming back with incomplete replacement parts, and seems randomly keep trying different things. Neither side seems to care of the fact that we bought an expensive dishwasher, and we have now spent more than half the time we've owned this thing without a functioning dishwasher or anybody taking responsibility to fix It. At this point, it's clear that there is a serious problem with this model. They have all but admitted this. But they're still not willing to take responsibility, after all this time they won't even consider replacing it. It almost seems like they're trying to wait out the time so that they can wash their hands off of this. It is shameful on both Costco and Bosch. The way they have treated us during this interaction have soured us on both companies. Both of them are at this point responsible since both sides have been told countless times about the endless details, the back-and-forth, the runaround that we've been getting. But still here we are. No one knows how long it will take or if they ever will resolve this issue. To say that we are frustrated would be an understatement at this point. Terrible product and even worse customer service from both companies.

Sentence (English): As this was my first time using a dishwasher, I had high expectations and many questions.
Comments (English): As this was my first time using a dishwasher, I had high expectations and many questions. My husband doesn't like washing dishes immediately after meals, while I feel more at ease doing them right away, so I decided to purchase one to reduce the burden of housework after work. At first, I thought I could just put the dishes in and run it, but after actually using it, I realized there were more maintenance steps than I had anticipated. It is recommended to pre-wash food residue to some extent, and you must use dishwasher-specific detergent, rinse aid, and salt. I was also advised to clean the internal filter after each use. The installation technician gave a detailed explanation on how to keep the appliance clean for a long time and provided great care tips, which was very helpful. As a first-time user, this explanation was particularly useful. However, unlike what I expected—that it would lighten the load—it turned out to be an appliance that requires more attention than I anticipated. Of course, since it cleans much better than hand-washing, it is worth knowing beforehand that it is not a product that requires absolutely no maintenance.
